_what: Points PICKED by Claude on grid crops of reference skull 20 (tools/grid_crop.py; engine-grounding G4: code proposes, a picker picks, code checks). FULL-image pixel coordinates of cases/cat1/references/20_Hauskatze_Schaedel_PP_noBG.jpg. Confidence 'picked' (~ +-15 px = +-1 mm) unless noted.

jaw_line.note: the OCCLUSAL line where the upper and lower teeth meet, incisors to the front of the ramus: the boundary of cranium and mandible (layered-build: where the mouth crease can be)

tmj.note: mandibular condyle in its fossa, under the arch's posterior root

ramus_top.note: front edge of the ramus, coronoid tip (HIDDEN behind the arch: inferred, flagged), mandibular notch, condyle

arch.note: zygomatic arch centreline from the squamosal root above the TMJ to the maxillary root

frontal_process_tip.note: postorbital process of the frontal (points down/back from the brow)

jugal_process_tip.note: frontal process of the jugal (points up from the arch); the gap to the frontal's process = the incomplete postorbital bar

orbit_rim_box.note: rough bounds of the orbit opening (brow above, arch below, postorbital processes behind)

meatus.note: external acoustic meatus (ear canal opening) on the bulla

mandible_angle.note: angular process, ventral-posterior corner of the mandible

orbit_rim_box_image_left.note: the skull's RIGHT orbit (front view: image right = the skull's left)

nasal_aperture_box.note: search box; the aperture itself = the dark region inside (auto, checked on the overlay)

coronoid_tips.note: the mandible's coronoid processes seen through the orbit gaps

mandible_ventral_lobes.note: the two bumps of the mandible's ventral border either side of the midline notch (front view): the halves stay close below the tooth row
